judgment_refs.note: Original wait, signal, turn and later opposing response are measured without a priority verdict.

sweep_specs.rationale: Sample two requested release times across initial-hazard passage while retaining the later opposing vehicle and signal phase.

axes.range_rationale: Two contrasting requested releases around the fixed initial passage; no legal time threshold.
axes.feasibility_evidence: Exact CPU offline bundles and synthetic saved-source comparison.
